entries.en: (Error)
*chuckle* Your partner is so weak. Now,[n]what to do...?
Won't you listen to my request? I require[n][f 2 5 3 9999 3].
Such an amateur you have for a partner.[n]That's why they're in this position now.
...Do you want to save them? Then I'd[n]like to have [var 0] yen.
Human life is so frail... Your partner will[n]soon expire at this rate...
If you want to prevent misfortune, then[n]won't you share some of your health[n]with me?
Your partner's fate is in my hands...[n]Do you understand the situation you[n]find yourself in?
If you share some of your stamina with[n]me, I'll be sure to entertain your request.
Fine, you win.
I can't meet your demands.
Call Thieves Guild ([var 5] left).
[clr 2]You're up, Panther.[clr 27]
...You must know, this isn't nearly enough[n]to give me satisfaction.
Won't you give me [f 2 5 3 9999 3][n]this time? Show me once more that[n]you care about your partner.
...Dear me, this still isn't enough to[n]satisfy me.
This time, give me [var 0] yen. Do that,[n]and everyone can be happy.
...You won't mind me asking for a little[n]more, right?
I'd like a sip of your health. If it's for your[n]partner, I'm sure you'll be willing to pay[n]the price.
Hmm... I'm not satisfied.
This is for your sake to form a true[n]friendship. Next, I ask for some of[n]your stamina.
...You've given me enough. I'm satisfied.[n]It's about time I release your partner.
...I grow weary from this. I'll return your[n]partner to you.
Oh, you're abandoning your partner?[n]What a coldhearted man...
*chuckle* Is that your answer? Then I'll[n]play a little rougher with your partner...
Humans truly are horrid creatures. So,[n]your partners are disposable?
I've lost interest all interest I had. Do[n]what you please...
You're abandoning your partner? Looks[n]like we've seen a glimpse into your true[n]nature...
...To think I had become invested in a[n]man like you. We're through! Goodbye!
Well, I'll be taking my leave. If you[n]become manlier someday, I'll have[n]you keep me company again.
I know you find me alluring, but please,[n]don't come after me anymore...
...It's time we return to our rightful places.
...Looks like our fates were not destined[n]to cross. Let us return to our rightful[n]places.
Wait, what's the meaning of this!? Are[n]there more of you!?
Y-You! You have quite cowardly friends!
What's with this woman...? Fine, I'll[n]forgive you for [f 2 5 3 9999 3].
Ugh, shut up! I'll let you leave if you[n]give me [var 0] yen!
This is why I can't stand young girls...[n]I'll let you off the hook if you give me[n]some of your health.
This is why I can't stand young girls...[n]Very well, I'll let them go if I can have[n]some of your stamina.
Yikes, is she touched in the head? I don't[n]want to get involved, so I'll be leaving.
Is she always like this? ...Like I care.[n]Goodbye.
You don't have it, do you? Ugh, you liar!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No... How could you take that from us?
Another band of thieves[n]responded to the call!
